reserveReview.rationale: Refresh 2026-09-28: Tori's Accountable feed renamed two of its four categories. At data.ts 2026-09-28T20:16:00Z the assetBreakdown reported money markets 67.75662145998768%, on-chain liquidity 14.52532933789746%, cash and equivalents 9.23243077800859%, and delta-neutral equity arbitrage 8.485618424106262% of the USD 78,223,339.40 total_reserves, summing to 100%. Delta-neutral equity arbitrage is itemized (underlying_exposure/equity_exposure as of 2026-09-23) as a USD 5,890,059.49 long book against USD -6,447,026.94 short single-stock futures (memo) with a USD -556,967.44 net equity delta, consistent with the docs' buy-spot/sell-futures arbitrage; Accountable lists its liquidity as listed equities and exchange-traded derivatives with a 2 business-day time to cash, so it is classified as a high-risk hedged-market position (seven-day horizon), not a cash equivalent. On-chain liquidity is itemized as USDC - Morpho USD 10,052,591.42, USDC USD 1,202,921.38 and USDT USD 106,501.92 on Ethereum plus dust ETH/AUSD and Base balances, publicly verified from blockchain wallets and DeFi protocol data with a same-day time to cash; because 88% is a Morpho lending position it is classified as a medium-risk protocol position rather than a stablecoin buffer. Accountable verifies liabilities from the trUSD contract and asset values from custodian, asset-manager and venue connectors every 15 minutes; the strategy-level split is therefore treated as verified, with undisclosed custodian and venue identities kept as risk factors.
reserveReview.compositionBasis: Timestamped Accountable Tori assetBreakdown snapshot cross-checked against Tori's live proof-of-solvency itemization; Accountable liquidity/time-to-cash classes; Tori strategy and backing docs; verified ToriMinting contract source.
reserveReview.knownUnknownExposure: Custodian bank, investment-bank, and execution-venue identities are undisclosed by policy, venue-level allocations and leverage are unpublished, the Morpho vault behind the USDC - Morpho line is not named, and the size of the protocol reserve fund is undisclosed. These gaps affect custody/counterparty risk assessment, not the verified strategy-level composition split. The 14.52532933789746% on-chain liquidity bucket combines a Morpho USDC position with directly held USDC and USDT in one live category.
